about.title: About GDY
about.subtitle: A professional manufacturer in the protective film industry
about.lead: Shenzhen Guangdayuan Film Co., Ltd. — more than 20 years focused on the research, development and manufacturing of protective film series of new materials, delivering stable and reliable surface protection to customers worldwide.
about.missionText: To provide customers with stable and reliable surface protection solutions — the right film, the right adhesion, delivered on time.
about.visionText: To be the most trusted protective film partner for electronics, automotive and new-energy manufacturers across Asia and beyond.
paragraphs: Founded in 2004, GDY operates a 16,000 m² production base with Class-100,000 and Class-1,000 cleanrooms and three fully automatic coating lines — an annual capacity of 120 million m².

Equipment includes blown film machines, coating machines, automatic cutting tables, slitters and laminators. Base films sourced from Japan's Toray and Toyobo, together with a joint R&D laboratory with Harbin Institute of Technology, keep quality stable from batch to batch.

Our products serve aerospace, electronics, communications, building materials, transport, home appliances, medical care, construction and infrastructure industries, and are exported to more than 40 countries.

quality.title: Quality & Technology

quality.certsIntro: Our management systems are certified to international standards. Certificate documents are being uploaded and can be provided upon request.

equipment.name: Blown Film Machines
equipment.desc: PE film extrusion lines for stable substrate quality.

equipment.name: Precision Coaters
equipment.desc: Adhesive coating lines controlling coating weight and uniformity.

equipment.name: Slitters & Laminators
equipment.desc: Automatic cutting tables, slitters and laminators for custom widths and lengths.

equipment.name: Testing Instruments
equipment.desc: Peel strength testers, tensile testers, thickness gauges and aging ovens for lot-by-lot verification.

quality.processIntro: Every batch passes through the same inspection chain before shipment.

steps.title: Incoming Material Inspection
steps.desc: Substrate film and adhesive raw materials are checked against specifications before entering production.

steps.title: In-Process Monitoring
steps.desc: Coating weight, thickness and appearance are sampled during production runs.

steps.title: Finished Roll Testing
steps.desc: Peel strength, tensile strength, elongation and residue tests on finished rolls.

steps.title: Pre-Shipment Re-Check
steps.desc: Appearance, dimensions and packaging are re-verified before loading.

steps.title: Traceability & Records
steps.desc: Batch records are kept so any shipment can be traced back to its raw materials and test data.
